output.narrative:
Revenue fell by -201.37 (-10.78%), driven primarily by a decrease in requests (-159.28) and a drop in ecpm (-43.5). The ecpm metric decreased by -0.0243 (-2.43%). 

At the top level, ecpm drops were concentrated in ad_format=video (explanatory_power 1.062, lift 8.13) and os_version=iOS 17.5 (explanatory_power 0.533, lift 2.77). Meanwhile, ad_format=banner with an explanatory power of -0.78 and lift of -2.24 was ruled out. 

Within ad_format=video, the drop further concentrates in os_version=iOS 17.5 (explanatory_power 0.472, lift 2.45) and country=ID (explanatory_power 0.418, lift 2.38). Within os_version=iOS 17.5, the drop is further concentrated in ad_format=video (explanatory_power 0.905, lift 6.91) and category=utility (explanatory_power 0.206, lift 1.84).
